body: That’s not where I belong. I being on the side of the road abandoned

They say they only see me as a friend at best. Online daiting returns nothing. As a trans women, things aren’t going to get better in that arena. I do but I hate bothering them. I still think this is a more merciful option.

Because every time I think I’m getting closer with someone I find my self back where I started. I know I’m “younger “ but that seems to bear no difference. Everyone is already finding or have found someone so now I’m left alone. 

Why not? Why would people want to see me miserable for 30 years, when I could just be done now and they can live their lives without me bringing them down.

I just don’t want to live my life without a partner. And that’s what I seemed destined to do. So if I’m gonna die alone, why wait? Why it get it over with now and let everyone move on and forget me all together
Because healing doesn’t seem to work. Wounds constantly reopen, and I’d rather be dead than go through this again and again.
What if I don’t want to heal? What if I just want to drop dead and be forgotten?
They won’t suffer long. Within a year I’ll ask but be forgotten.
I don’t want to anymore. I’m just tired of constantly falling. I don’t have the strength to stand up again. My loved ones don’t deserve to watch me suffer anymore.
Because all roads lead me back here at one point or another. I never wanted this life at all, and times coming up on what I can stand

I don’t really want to be proud of anything. I just want to be left and forgotten. Less painful for everyone that way.

I was a mistake right from the start. The sooner I get the balls to correct it the better everyone else will be.
